name: nagari-topic-entity-breakdown-2026
title: Nagari (Общество ревнителей санскрита) Topic/Entity Breakdown, 2005-2026
description: Derived, aggregate-only topic and entity tables for the nagari@googlegroups.com closed mailing-list archive (H1518). A curated two-level topic taxonomy (9 parents / 37 children) plus a texts/scholars/dictionaries/tools-and-places entity gazetteer are applied to every message; results are aggregated to thread-, topic-, and entity-level counts. No message body, subject full text, or email address is included -- only counts, topic/entity labels, and lemmatized phrase collocations.
rights: The source is a CLOSED mailing list (2,333 real members). This package contains only derived, aggregate-level outputs: topic/entity counts, thread-level topic assignment, and lemmatized phrase collocations. It carries NO email addresses (verified by scripts/audit_publish_surface.py) and NO message bodies. Author display names appear in thread_topics.csv/topic_authors.csv consistent with the existing, already-published site_data.json top_authors precedent; publication of names (not addresses) is the list owner's standing decision, documented in nagari/.ai_state.md. Full-text bodies and attachment blobs are never redistributed by this package or the accompanying page.

resources.name: topics_by_year.csv
resources.description: Message counts per topic (2-level taxonomy child label) per year.

resources.name: thread_topics.csv
resources.description: Thread-level topic assignment: primary topic + parent + matched entities + message count + year, one row per thread.

resources.name: entities_by_type.csv
resources.description: Total mention count per gazetteer entity (texts, scholars, dictionaries, tools/places), across the corpus.

resources.name: entity_trends.csv

resources.name: topic_cooccurrence.csv
resources.description: Undirected per-thread co-occurrence counts between topic pairs.

resources.name: topic_entity_matrix.csv
resources.description: Co-occurrence counts between topic labels and gazetteer entities.

resources.name: phrases.csv
resources.description: Multi-word key phrases: PMI/Dunning log-likelihood bigram collocations (method=llr) and TF-IDF single-term scores (method=tfidf), over lemmatized subjects+bodies.

resources.name: misc_audit_summary.json
resources.description: The 'fuller than surface' evidence: message count, misc-bucket count, and misc share for the current taxonomy.
